p.src: Policy continuity channel. Record whether liquidity, rates, and risk-spread conditions improved enough to claim an easier system.

u.src: Policy continuity channel. Record whether liquidity, rates, and risk-spread conditions improved enough to claim an easier system.
en: Policy continuity channel. Record whether liquidity, rates, and risk-spread conditions improved enough to claim an easier system.

p.src: Ownership access channel. Record whether first-time borrower access, small-firm entry durability, and debt-service burden improved together.

u.src: Ownership access channel. Record whether first-time borrower access, small-firm entry durability, and debt-service burden improved together.
en: Ownership access channel. Record whether first-time borrower access, small-firm entry durability, and debt-service burden improved together.

p.src: Apply the minimum comparison set below:

u.src: Apply the minimum comparison set below:
en: Apply the minimum comparison set below:

p.src: 1) If policy continuity is improving but access does not, keep the leverage plan defensive.

u.src: 1) If policy continuity is improving but access does not, keep the leverage plan defensive.
en: 1) If policy continuity is improving but access does not, keep the leverage plan defensive.

p.src: 2) If both channels improve for two windows, controlled ownership scaling can be reconsidered.

u.src: 2) If both channels improve for two windows, controlled ownership scaling can be reconsidered.
en: 2) If both channels improve for two windows, controlled ownership scaling can be reconsidered.

p.src: 3) If physical capacity or labor-cost pressure remains tight while channel convergence is weak, prefer reversible options and runway over irreversible leverage.

u.src: 3) If physical capacity or labor-cost pressure remains tight while channel convergence is weak, prefer reversible options and runway over irreversible leverage.
en: 3) If physical capacity or labor-cost pressure remains tight while channel convergence is weak, prefer reversible options and runway over irreversible leverage.

p.src: If this portability drill cannot show co-improving first-time access and debt-service burden, the policy lesson should not be copied directly as a personal rule.
